basic_details.job_title: Indian Coast Guard Assistant Director Recruitment 2027 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications)

qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree of a recognised University in Hindi or English (with the other language at degree level), or in any other subject with Hindi and English at degree level as specified, plus three years' terminology and translation experience or three years' teaching or research experience in Hindi/English. Must be a Central/State/UT officer holding an analogous post on regular basis or with three years' regular service in Level-7.
qualification.details: Qualification: Officers of the Central Government or State Governments or Union territories holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent Cadre or Department, OR with three years' regular service in posts in Level-7 in the pay matrix (Rs. 44900-142400) or equivalent; Master's degree of a recognised University in Hindi with English as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at the degree level; OR Master's degree of a recognised University in English with Hindi as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at the degree level; OR Master's degree of a recognised University in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi medium and English as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at the degree level; OR Master's degree of a recognised University in any subject other than Hindi or English, with English medium and Hindi as a compulsory or elective subject or as a medium of examination at the degree level; OR Master's degree of a recognised University in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi and English as compulsory or elective subjects or either of the two as a medium of examination and the other as a compulsory or elective subject at the degree level Experience: Three years experience of using or applying terminology (terminological work) in Hindi and translation work from English to Hindi or vice-versa, preferably of technical or scientific literature, under Central or State Governments, autonomous bodies, statutory organisations, PSUs, Universities or recognised research or educational institutions; OR three years experience of teaching in Hindi and English or research in Hindi or English under such bodies. Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications) | Other conditions: | Open to officers from the Central Government or State Governments or Union territories Must hold an analogous post on regular basis in the parent Cadre or Department, or have three years' regular service in Level-7 (Rs. 44900-142400) or equivalent The employing department must confirm that the officer will be relieved from duties in the event of selection | Desirable: | Studied one of the languages other than Hindi included in the 8th Schedule of the Constitution at 10th level from a recognised board

how_to_apply: Fill the application in the prescribed bio-data proforma, available on the Indian Coast Guard website www.indiancoastguard.gov.in and attached to the notice.
Attach the complete and up-to-date ACR/APAR dossiers or attested photocopies of the ACRs/APAR for the last 05 years.
The employer completes and verifies the certificate appended to the proforma and confirms the officer will be relieved if selected.
Forward the application to Directorate of EP & CP, {for Director(CP)}, Coast Guard Headquarters, National Stadium Complex, New Delhi-110001.
Applications must be received within 60 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in the Employment News dated 07-13 Nov 2026.
Make sure it reaches by 12 January 2027.
important_instructions: Applications received after the last date, or without the ACRs/APAR/Educational Certificates, or otherwise incomplete will not be considered While forwarding the applications, the certificate appended to the proforma may also be verified

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Officers of the Central Government or State Governments or Union territories holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent Cadre or Department, OR with three years' regular service in posts in Level-7 in the pay matrix (Rs. 44900-142400) or equivalent; Master's degree of a recognised University in Hindi with English as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at the degree level; OR Master's degree of a recognised University in English with Hindi as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at the degree level; OR Master's degree of a recognised University in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi medium and English as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at the degree level; OR Master's degree of a recognised University in any subject other than Hindi or English, with English medium and Hindi as a compulsory or elective subject or as a medium of examination at the degree level; OR Master's degree of a recognised University in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi and English as compulsory or elective subjects or either of the two as a medium of examination and the other as a compulsory or elective subject at the degree level Experience: Three years experience of using or applying terminology (terminological work) in Hindi and translation work from English to Hindi or vice-versa, preferably of technical or scientific literature, under Central or State Governments, autonomous bodies, statutory organisations, PSUs, Universities or recognised research or educational institutions; OR three years experience of teaching in Hindi and English or research in Hindi or English under such bodies. Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications) Other conditions: Open to officers from the Central Government or State Governments or Union territories Must hold an analogous post on regular basis in the parent Cadre or Department, or have three years' regular service in Level-7 (Rs. 44900-142400) or equivalent The employing department must confirm that the officer will be relieved from duties in the event of selection Desirable: Studied one of the languages other than Hindi included in the 8th Schedule of the Constitution at 10th level from a recognised board

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for ICG Recruitment 2027
content_sections.text: Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion are not eligible for appointment on deputation Deputationists shall not be eligible for consideration for appointment by promotion

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initial period of deputation: one year Period of deputation, including deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before, shall ordinarily not exceed 03 years Selected officers governed by DoP&T OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay II) dated 17th June, 2010 as amended from time to time

rows.event: Advertisement in Employment News (issue dated 07-13 Nov 2026)

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed bio-data proforma Complete and up-to-date ACR/APAR dossiers, or attested photocopies of the ACRs/APAR for the last 05 years Educational certificates Employer's certificate: information verified from service record, no disciplinary/vigilance case pending or contemplated, no minor or major penalty in the last 10 years, officer will be relieved if selected Photocopies of ACRs/APAR for the last five years duly attested by a Group 'A' officer

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date, or without the ACRs/APAR/Educational Certificates, or otherwise incomplete will not be considered While forwarding the applications, the certificate appended to the proforma may also be verified

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ICG Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 15 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ICG Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Assistant Director (Official Language).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ICG Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Bio-data proforma attached to the notice (pages 3-5), also available on the Indian Coast Guard website www.indiancoastguard.gov.in) and send it to Directorate of EP & CP, {for Director(CP)}, Coast Guard Headquarters, National Stadium Complex, New Delhi-110001, by post, to reach by 15 January 2027.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Level-10 (Rs. 56100-177500) in the pay matrix.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's degree of a recognised University in Hindi or English (with the other language at degree level), or in any other subject with Hindi and English at degree level as specified, plus three years' terminology and translation experience or three years' teaching or research experience in Hindi/English. Must be a Central/State/UT officer holding an analogous post on regular basis or with three years' regular service in Level-7.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open to officers from the Central Government or State Governments or Union territories. Must hold an analogous post on regular basis in the parent Cadre or Department, or have three years' regular service in Level-7 (Rs. 44900-142400) or equivalent. The employing department must confirm that the officer will be relieved from duties in the event of selection.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion are not eligible for appointment on deputation. Deputationists shall not be eligible for consideration for appointment by promotion.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initial period of deputation: one year. Period of deputation, including deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before, shall ordinarily not exceed 03 years. Selected officers governed by DoP&T OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay II) dated 17th June, 2010 as amended from time to time.

faq.answer: Mumbai (subject to change).
